source_repository.note: The copied source surfaces are bound by the SHA256 digests recorded below and may include local modifications beyond the recorded source-repository HEAD commit.

paper_reference_capsule.note: This is a verbatim mirror of the published public release allowlist intended as the primary paper-referenceable sidecar capsule.

aiir.note: Exact receipt ids, filenames, per-artifact hashes, and Rekor entry details are recorded in aiir/BUNDLESET.json. This packet-bound manifest intentionally avoids duplicating receipt-specific coordinates so the AIIR lane stays authoritative without forcing the packet receipt to chase its own hash.

supports: tamper-evident integrity for the full copied paper-facing public capsule mirror in `capsule/`
tamper-evident integrity for the copied sidecar packet files in this repository

identity-pinned Sigstore signing for the AIIR receipt set under `noah@invariantsystems.io` via `https://accounts.google.com`

does_not_support: independent preregistration of the current NISQ study

future_policy.policy_note: Future campaigns should commit the declared plan hash here on day zero and mirror the same hash to at least one external transparency log.
